actions.name: createEvent
openCalendar
actions.description: Open Calendar app and bring to front
actions.payload: openApplication:Calendar

actions.name: showTodayView
actions.payload:
tell application "Calendar"
    activate
    tell application "System Events" to keystroke "t" using command down
end tell

actions.name: deleteEvent
actions.description: Delete a calendar event by title
actions.payload:
tell application "Calendar"
    repeat with c in calendars
        set matchingEvents to (events of c whose summary is "$TITLE")
        repeat with e in matchingEvents
            delete e
        end repeat
    end repeat
end tell
actions.safetyWarning: This will permanently delete matching events

actions.name: listTodayEvents
actions.description: List all events scheduled for today
actions.payload:
tell application "Calendar"
    set today to current date
    set time of today to 0
    set tomorrow to today + (1 * days)
    set output to ""
    repeat with c in calendars
        set todayEvents to (events of c whose start date >= today and start date < tomorrow)
        repeat with e in todayEvents
            set output to output & summary of e & return
        end repeat
    end repeat
    return output
end tell

knownIssues.description: Calendar names vary by user; 'Home' may not exist
Date parsing in AppleScript depends on system locale
knownIssues.workaround: Use ISO date format when possible

actions.name: createReminder
completeReminder
actions.payload:
tell application "Reminders"
    set targetReminder to first reminder whose name is "$TITLE"
    set completed of targetReminder to true
end tell

actions.name: deleteReminder
actions.payload:
tell application "Reminders"
    delete (first reminder whose name is "$TITLE")
end tell
actions.safetyWarning: This will permanently delete the reminder

actions.name: listReminders
actions.payload:
tell application "Reminders"
    set output to ""
    set incompleteReminders to (reminders whose completed is false)
    repeat with r in incompleteReminders
        set output to output & name of r & return
    end repeat
    return output
end tell

knownIssues.description: Accessing reminders from specific lists requires knowing list names
knownIssues.workaround: Operate on default list or query lists first

actions.name: createNote
actions.description: Create a new note with body text

actions.name: appendToNote
actions.description: Append text to an existing note
actions.payload:
tell application "Notes" set targetNote to first note whose name is "$TITLE" set body of targetNote to (body of targetNote) & "
" & "$TEXT" end tell

actions.name: searchNotes
actions.payload:
tell application "Notes"
    set output to ""
    set matchingNotes to (notes whose name contains "$QUERY")
    repeat with n in matchingNotes
        set output to output & name of n & return
    end repeat
    return output
end tell

actions.name: composeEmail
actions.description: Open a new email composition window
actions.payload:
tell application "Mail"
    activate
    set newMessage to make new outgoing message with properties {subject:"$SUBJECT", content:"$BODY", visible:true}
    tell newMessage
        make new to recipient at end of to recipients with properties {address:"$TO"}
    end tell
end tell
actions.safetyWarning: Email will not be sent until user clicks Send

actions.name: sendEmail
actions.description: Compose and immediately send an email
actions.payload:
tell application "Mail"
    set newMessage to make new outgoing message with properties {subject:"$SUBJECT", content:"$BODY", visible:false}
    tell newMessage
        make new to recipient at end of to recipients with properties {address:"$TO"}
    end tell
    send newMessage
end tell
actions.safetyWarning: This will send the email immediately without review

actions.name: checkMail
actions.payload:
tell application "Mail"
    activate
    check for new mail
end tell

examples.userIntent: Send an email to John about the meeting

knownIssues.description: Sending email requires configured mail accounts
knownIssues.workaround: Verify Mail is configured before using send actions

knownIssues.description: HTML body content may not render correctly via AppleScript
knownIssues.workaround: Use plain text for body content
